The '''Ord Marsax system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Marsax]].
